segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And before we continue, let me just say a few words on the discussions today.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: First and foremost, let me commend our Chairman, Senator Javier Cito, for restoring the foreign-assisted projects almost to its fullest amount in the NEP.

segments.text: And foreign-assisted projects is important next year because this will deliver long-term growth for our country.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So we commend our Chairman for...

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
